bands.name: ALSTK
bands.description: The sum of stocking percent values of all live trees on the condition.

bands.name: BALIVE
bands.description: Basal area in square feet per acre of all live trees greater than or equal to 1.0 inch d.b.h./d.r.c. sampled in the condition.

bands.name: CANOPYPCT
bands.description: Live canopy cover percent derived from the Forest Vegetation Simulator.

bands.name: CARBON_D
bands.description: Carbon, standing dead (tons per acre)
bands.treemap:source: Query; Sum (DRYBIO_BOLE, DRYBIO_TOP, DRYBIO_STUMP, DRYBIO_SAPLING, DRYBIO_WDLD_SPP) / 2 /2000*TPA_UNADJ WHERE (((COND.COND_STATUS_CD)=1) AND ((TREE.STATUSCD)=2) AND ((TREE.DIA)>=5) AND ((TREE.STANDING_DEAD_CD)=1))

bands.name: CARBON_DWN
bands.description: Carbon (tons per acre) of woody material greater than 3 inches in diameter on the ground, and stumps and their roots greater than 3 inches in diameter. Estimated from models based on geographic area, forest type, and live tree carbon density (Smith and Heath 2008).

TreeMap2023_CONUS_FLDTYPCD.title: Field forest-type code

bands.name: FLDTYPCD
bands.description: A code indicating the forest type, assigned by the field crew, based on the tree species or species groups forming a plurality of all live stocking. The field crew assesses the forest type based on the acre of forest land around the plot, in  addition to the species sampled on the condition. See Appendix D of the FIA database documentation for a table of values.

bands.name: GSSTK
bands.description: The sum of stocking percent values of all growing-stock trees on the condition.

bands.name: QMD
bands.description: The quadratic mean diameter (QMD), or the diameter of the tree of average basal area, on the condition. Based on live trees greater than or equal to 1.0 inch d.b.h./d.r.c.

bands.name: SDIsum
bands.description: Stand density index (SDI). A relative measure of stand density for live trees (greater than or equal to 1.0 inch d.b.h./d.r.c.) on the condition. Unitless.
bands.treemap:source: Query; SDIsum =  ∑(TREE.TPA_UNADJi * (TREE.DIAi/10)1.605), where TPA_UNADJi is the number of trees per acre represented by the ith tree on the plot and DIA is the diameter of the ith tree on the plot and TREE.STATUSCD=1

bands.name: STANDHT
bands.description: Height of dominant trees, in feet, derived from the Forest Vegetation Simulator.
